home.heroSubtitle: Build web apps from a single sentence
home.promptPlaceholder: e.g. Build me a personal blog website

blog.label: Personal Blog
blog.prompt: Create a modern personal blog website with article list, detail pages, categories and tags, search, a comment system, and an about page. Clean design, responsive layout, Markdown support, with latest posts and popular picks on the home page.

corporate.label: Corporate Site
corporate.prompt: Design a professional corporate website with company intro, products & services, news, and contact pages. Business style with hero carousel, product cards, team section and client cases, multi-language support and online chat.

shop.label: Online Store
shop.prompt: Build a fully functional online store with product listings, cart, user sign-up/login, order management and checkout. Modern product card layout with search and filters, reviews, coupons and a loyalty points system.

portfolio.label: Portfolio
portfolio.prompt: Create an elegant portfolio website for designers, photographers and artists. Include a gallery, project detail pages, resume and contact modules. Use a masonry or grid layout with image zoom preview and category filters.
